messages:
Ena: Heads-up: deploybot attempted to unpin runtime 2.14 -> 3.0 in APAC at 03:00 UTC but found a mismatch against the pinlist; some model groups were unintentionally targeted.
Raj: Got a notification from deploybot. What mismatch exactly?
deploybot: deploybot: preflight failed — pinlist diff contains unexpected model bindings. Affected model ids: m-91b2, m-44f1. Action: abort until manual review.
Marta: Those two are internal experimental forks; they should have been excluded by the staging config. Looks like pin-exempt label didn't propagate.
Ena: Can we quickly patch the pinlist and re-run preflight? This is a small time window for APAC maintenance.
Raj: Patch allowed but please don't rush. We should add an explicit exclusion and run a dry-run first. Also capture a snapshot of which nodes would receive traffic.
Marta: I'll update pinlist and add comments: exclude m-91b2,m-44f1; also add provenance tag so deploybot can verify origin.
ops-bot: ops-bot: staging pinlist patch queued. Dry-run will run in 2m, capacity check included.
deploybot: deploybot: dry-run results: routing would affect 5% of APAC pool; excluded ids honored; no image-signature issues. Ready for manual apply.
Ena: Good. Rollout plan: 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 90m, automatic step on metric checks. Rollback triggers: p95 latency +40% or increase in retryable errors >0.7%.
Raj: Add model-level compatibility check: ensure quantized models on nodes have kernel match; if mismatch, exclude model id automatically.
Marta: Agree. I added a kernel-compat check to the runbook and to deploybot preflight.
docs-bot: docs-bot: posted an internal blurb for release notes draft and will ping CS after apply.
Ena: One more: coordinate with SDK team. runtime 3.0 introduces new concat-kv flag; older SDKs might not set it and could get degraded perf. Juan? (cc SDK lead)
Raj: I'll ping SDK leads in parallel. Also capture perf profiles at each step.
Ena: Ok, unless anyone objects I'll apply the patched pinlist in 5m and flip deploybot to live.
Marta: ack.
Raj: ack, monitoring watches set.
ops-bot: ops-bot: live apply executed by @Ena at 2026-04-02T03:05:00Z. Pre-checks green.
Ena: Starting 10% step now. Olivia will run long-seq smoke and kernel probe.
Marta: Noted — watching for any model-specific kernel failures.
deploybot: deploybot: 10% cohort switched. Telemetry tag: rollout-6855551234.
Raj: p95 looks stable so far. No retry spikes.
Olivia: Long-seq smoke passed. Kernel probe shows expected concat-kv present on 90% of sample nodes.
Ena: Proceed to 50%.
deploybot: deploybot: 50% cohort switched.
ops-bot: ops-bot: automatic cache drain executed on switched nodes.
Raj: Small p95 blip in one AZ, but within thresholds. Watching.
Marta: Model m-44f1 reported a kernel mismatch in one host and was auto-excluded by the compatibility rule. Good.
Ena: Proceed to 100%.
deploybot: deploybot: 100% cohort switched. Rollout complete in APAC.
Ena: Post-rollout checks: embedding vector fidelity sample, SDK telemetry (concat-kv header), top-5 customer smoke.
Raj: All green so far. No customer-impact alerts.
Marta: I'll backfill the pinlist commit with an annotated changelog.
docs-bot: docs-bot: final release note ready: "Runtime 3.0 rollout to APAC — model-level compatibility safeguards enabled; SDK note: upgrade to SDK >=2.9 recommended for best perf."
Ena: Thanks team. Closing thread; will open follow-up for EU region next week.
